steps.title: Trouble in the temple
steps.text: Enter the Mourners' headquarters in the north-eastern corner of West Ardougne.
Search the Head Mourner's desk for the tarnished and new key.
Chant-to the blank teleport crystal on the marked tile.
Return to the Mourners' headquarters basement.
Kill a mourner nearby for a second mourner outfit.
Use a piece of mourner's outfit on Arianwyn in Lletya.
Use the enchanted crystal on Arianwyn.

Talk to Arianwyn again.
  • Dismiss your pet/familiar.
  • Make sure to have your second set of mourner gear equipped or in your inventory.

actions.text: About those tasks I need to do...

steps.title: The death altar
steps.text:
Climb up the staircase.
  • Equip your tank gear/shield.
Climb up the staircase to the south.
Climb down the staircase to the north.
Pass through the light door to the death altar.
Use the crystal trinket on the energised pillar.

Talk to Arianwyn.
  • Speak to Arianwyn again if you need a death talisman.

actions.text: I'm not even going to argue.

steps.title: Energized
steps.text: Talk to Thorgel. Do the next steps quickly.

Investigate the crystal to the south-east.
  • If your character speaks, you have to start from the beginning.

Touch the energized pillar.
  • If you don't get transported, you were not fast enough.
Watch the cutscene. Don't click anywhere in the cutscene.
The solution to this puzzle differs player to player. Refer to the wiki for an explanation on how to solve this. Sorry.
Climb the ladder to the south-east.

steps.title: Sharpshooter
steps.text: Follow the path while avoiding the spikes.
Shoot the ballista to hit the target.
Jump to the ladder at the end of the path.
